svg.title: Vertical asymptotes of r(x) = x/((x − 1)(x + 2))
svg.desc: The graph of r(x) = x/((x − 1)(x + 2)) with dashed vertical asymptotes x = −2 and x = 1. As x approaches −2 from the left the outputs decrease without bound, and from the right they increase without bound. As x approaches 1 from the left the outputs decrease without bound, and from the right they increase without bound.
